judge.rationale: The candidate invented its own frame names and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of using the ones explicitly specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, making the feature always-on by default. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`), which directly violates the ticket's requirement and acceptance criteria to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame and never send an empty list. In `validation.ts`, the candidate allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of enforcing the 1–200 range required by the ticket. Finally, it logged raw store error messages (violating the security/GDPR requirement to not leak store details) and omitted the changes to `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`.
